title: Smoked Pork with Creamy Bisque
description: A rich and creamy bisque paired with tender smoked pork, perfect for a comforting meal.

ingredients.name: Smoked Pork Shoulder
ingredients.notes: Look for a smoked pork shoulder with a good bark

instructions: 2. Place the smoked pork shoulder on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes per pound, or until the internal temperature reaches 160°F (71°C).
3. While the pork is cooking, melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat.
4. Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
6. Sprinkle the flour over the onion mixture and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
7. Gradually add the chicken broth, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
8. Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 10 minutes.
9. Stir in the heavy cream and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the bisque has thickened slightly.
10. Season the bisque with salt and pepper to taste.
11. Once the pork is cooked, let it rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
12. Serve the sliced pork with the creamy bisque spooned over the top.
